item.title: Applied Data Science Lab
item.description: 🔗 Certification Description It took nearly 5 months to complete 8 data science projects. From the first project to the last, I learned about various aspects and tools of data science. Furthermore, I’ve experimented with several components of the project locally for my own enjoyment. This covers: ✅ Exploratory Data Analysis ✅ Data Wrangling ✅ Data Visualization ✅ Work with Imbalanced data using resampling ✅ Python OOP ✅ MongoDB ✅ SQL
